candidates.claim: The new row-action toggles are icon-only Buttons with only a title and no aria-label. Screen readers may announce nothing reliable for the control in every key-manager list row.
candidates.evidence: B.14 / Quick Reject: "Icon-only button without `aria-label`". Code: <Button icon="moreVert" title={t`Secret actions`} /> (same in ContainerTableRow.tsx:39, OrderTableRow.tsx:38). example: packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/storage/-components/Ceph/Buckets/BucketHeaderActions.tsx:67
candidates.precedent: FloatingIpDetailsView.tsx:66 also uses title only; Ceph and flavors pair title with aria-label.

candidates.claim: Accessible names/tooltips "Secret actions", "Container actions", "Order actions" are not title case, unlike sibling labels "Bucket actions"-style/"More Actions" in the reference modules.
candidates.evidence: B.19: "Title case for ... button labels". example: packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/compute/flavors/$flavorId.tsx:227 ("More Actions")
candidates.precedent: Ceph BucketHeaderActions.tsx:67 uses lowercase "Bucket actions" too.

candidates.claim: CreateOrderModal shows validation errors as the user types, derived on every render, instead of on blur / submit. Clearing the Algorithm field immediately paints an error before the field is left, and the Create button is disabled with no submit-time revalidation.
candidates.evidence: B.11: "Validate **on blur** by default; always re-validate all fields **on submit**. Validate **as-you-type** only for strict-format fields"; Algorithm and Bit Length are not strict-format fields. Errors are computed from state at lines 43-46 and passed to errortext (94-107) with no touched/blur tracking. example: packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/compute/flavors/-components/CreateFlavorModal.tsx:225
candidates.precedent: Not a Reject-line violation by itself (initial defaults are valid, so nothing shows before interaction).

candidates.claim: Each list adds a useEffect that calls onPageChange when the current page becomes empty. This is event-driven state sync that could be done in the delete handler or by clamping the page, and it runs in three components.
candidates.evidence: A.1: "Critically evaluate every `useEffect` ... Flag synchronizations, computed states, or event-driven triggers ... that can be handled during rendering or inside event handlers". Effect: if (!isLoading && !isError && page > 1 && (data?.secrets.length ?? 0) === 0) onPageChange(page - 1). Same in OrdersList.tsx:53 and ContainersList.tsx:48. The trigger is the delete mutation's onSuccess in the Delete*Modal.

candidates.claim: The new useKeyManagerPermissions import uses a two-level relative path (`../../`) in the changed lines instead of the `@/` alias.
candidates.evidence: Quick Reject: "Import using `../../` traversal beyond one level instead of `@/`"; B.13: "No relative `../../` traversal beyond one level". Lines: import { useKeyManagerPermissions } from "../../-components/useKeyManagerPermissions" (also ContainersList.tsx:4, OrdersList.tsx:12, SecretDetailsView.tsx:8). example: packages/aurora/src/client/routes/_auth/projects/$projectId/compute/flavors/-components/CreateFlavorModal.tsx:17
candidates.precedent: The old usePermissions import used the same ../../ path; the PR renamed it but kept it.
